purpose: Teach: 魔王/アーケード/パイプライン/抗体/動植物/音階/鷲/製鉄

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが孫に魔王のお話をされた
lines.en: You know, when your father was young, he used to tell the grandchildren stories about demons.
lines.style: Slow, measured cadence. Soft, distant gaze. Voice carries the weight of memory — not sad, but tender with time. Slight pause before speaking, as if reaching back decades.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、商店街のアーケードでよく買い物されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and didn't you used to shop in the shopping arcade with your grandfather quite often, dear?
lines.style: Warm, conversational. Gently correcting or redirecting — not scolding. A hint of playful memory in the lilt. Affectionate address pulls him back into the moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがパイプライン工事に携われた
lines.en: When he was younger, your father was involved in pipeline construction work.
lines.style: Voice quieter now, more deliberate. Still reaching back, but grounding the memory in specifics. A slight firmness — not correcting her, but insisting on the truth of what he recalls.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様の抗体検査を心配されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather was so worried about getting the grandchildren checked for antibodies, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gently sidelong — she's noticing something, perhaps that he's drifting. Warm but with a subtle thread of care. The 'dear' is both intimate and grounding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが動植物の図鑑を集められた
lines.en: Your father collected illustrated books of animals and plants when he was young.
lines.style: Voice returns to that distant register. Each image offered plainly, as if reviewing a list he's held for years. Slower pace. The specificity is what matters to him.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様にピアノの音階を教えてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You taught the grandchildren piano scales, didn't you, dear? I remember that so well.
lines.style: Bright and certain — this one she knows. Affirming his memory with her own. A small warmth, almost playful. She's reminding him of something good he did.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが鷲の絵を描かれたぞ
lines.en: When your father was young, he drew pictures of eagles.
lines.style: Voice steadies with detail. There's something reverent about the image — eagles, drawn by hand. Quieter finish, trailing into the weight of that memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、製鉄所でお仕事されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: When you were young, you worked at the steel mill, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Soft, knowing lilt. She's offering him a mirror now — his own youth, his own hands that built things. Intimate, almost whispered. The 'dear' is tender and close.
